original_card.acceptance_gate: Bind every coefficient and depth factor to the selected producer and state the width domain. Compare a proved envelope with the sufficient cutoff guard; a large numerical headroom or a historical m=120 coefficient is not a selected m=73 proof.

Check whether newer handoffs already cover that exact obligation. actual_scope: Target 10 of #5428, one narrow lemma pair: (A) the completion/splitting pass of p7-TENSOR/higher-moment-strictification as a transformation of finite native units, executed event by event under the ownership invariants of #4691 with an exact record invoice; (B) nested owned-bank lifetimes in the FINITE-PRECOMPILATION lockstep schedule, a LIFO slot allocator and its peak recursion (the 'lifetime proof' that section 6 asks for).
scope_change_reason: Continues #4691 (same card, lockstep compiler ownership) toward the compiler/owned_erasure premises named in #5428 target 10; the stock-envelope card is the nearest existing card.
bottleneck_link: Side result for the retained compiler and owned-erasure premises: it makes one prescribed step of the compiler literal and reduces the owned-field inventory O in Z=W+O from instances to peak; it does not move the frontier.
stop_rule: Stop after event-level execution of the passed rules with the stack allocator on toy, p7-shaped and selected-shaped rules, the histogram identities on the complete p7 and selected profiles at v=1..3, and one-generation compiled counts; do not materialize the 1024-fold template or bind the literal selected chronology.
evidence: PROOF.md (Lemmas A and B); verify.py binds the source statements, checks counting parity with #4691, identity (1), surplus, separation and record counts on the complete profiles, executes the pass with the LIFO allocator and compares peak/total/records with the formulas, and freezes RESULT.json; test_verify.py has thirteen rejecting controls.
